parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH 6 + all shards (0-10) achieved 0.853872. It seems the larger batch (524288) is working well with high capacity. Next, I'll try halving the batch size to 262144 and adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if more optimizer steps + stabilization can push us even lower.
parsed.description: Halve batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps and add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 for stabilization.
